| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--cloud` | string | none | the cloud the instances live in, os-prod-eu1 for example |
| `--dump` | boolean | `false` | print the notifications the broker delivers as JSON lines |
| `--month` | string | `2026-01` | the calendar month to rate, as YYYY-MM |
| `--timeout` | duration | `30s` | how long one call may take |
| `--workers` | integer | `4` | how many resources are rated at once |
